P.name: Salvation
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Soraka''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|90% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that are {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.

Q.name: Starcall
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls down a star upon the target location that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area before landing after {{pp|type=target range|0.25 to 1 for 16|50 to 800}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 30% for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
Q.description2: If this hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, star dust returns to '''Soraka''', granting her ''Rejuvenation'' for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. While '''Soraka''' has ''Rejuvenation'', casting ''{{ai|Astral Infusion|Soraka}}'' will also grant ''Rejuvenation'' to the target for the same duration.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Rejuvenation}}: {{tip|Heal}} every {{fd|0.2}} seconds and gain {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over the duration.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Total Heal|{{ap|60 to 120}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}|Heal per Tick|{{ap|60/12 to 120/12}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/12}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 30}}%}}

W.name: Astral Infusion
W.description2: If cast while under ''{{ai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}}'', the {{as|health cost}} will be reduced by a percentage.
W.leveling2: {{st|Health Cost Reduction|{{ap|80 to 100}}%|Reduced Health Cost|{{as|{{ap|2 to 0}}% of '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description3: ''Astral Infusion'' cannot be cast if '''Soraka''' is below {{as|{{sti|5% of her '''maximum''' health}}}}.

E.name: Equinox
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' creates a celestial zone at the target location that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemy champions within at the time of cast. The zone then persists for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and {{tip|silence|silences}} enemies within.
E.description2: Afterwards, the zone erupts to deal the same damage to enemy champions within and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.
E.leveling2:
{{st|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|70*2 to 170*2}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1 to 2}} seconds}}

R.name: Wish
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Soraka''' calls upon the stars, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and all allied champions, increased by 50% on targets {{as|below 40% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
